task: Cover the Outfitters storefront. The product list (`/`) links to each product's own page, which shows that product's name and price. Add to wishlist on a product page saves it and the header's Wishlist count updates on every page. The Wishlist page (`/wishlist`) lists the saved products, and Remove takes one off; the wishlist is kept on the server, so it is the same after a reload. An unknown product URL such as `/products/99` shows the `Product not found` page.
